 Customer reported trouble activating a new SIM and encountering a prompt for Visa card details despite already paying. Agent explained the card entry is for ID verification only and will not be charged, and that the activation won’t complete without it. Customer also asked about porting an old Optus number; agent advised that if the old number is no longer active they cannot transfer it and the customer should select a new mobile number. Next step: customer will try the activation again and contact support if problems persist.
